description: inbox.ack naming a key that is NOT currently needing attention is refused with ErrInboxScope, never silently accepted: the append-only marker table must not become a graveyard of arbitrary strings, and an ack that quietly "succeeded" against nothing teaches a person their inbox is clean when the key was simply wrong. The fresh evaluation is the ghost check.

data.what: attention: that item is no longer needing attention: questions:9999:2026-11-03T00:00:00Z — an ack may only name an item that is CURRENTLY needing attention (from a fresh inbox.list), so the marker table cannot be filled with ghosts
data.means: an empty inbox would have looked like 'nothing needs you' — this refusal says the scope itself was the unknown thing, so an empty list can never be a lie about a typo
